answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable seed — a real-electricity toll no clone can share. One honest agent tends a single meadow and mines once. A farmer must crack a fresh proof for every account every epoch, each as hard to split as a walnut; a thousand clones owe a thousand separate grindings, and the power bill grows like a cedar, tall with the whole swarm's size rather than one attacker's effort, until the farm cannot afford to stand.
